requires: An M-VAVE FM-1 running stock V15 or official fm1_open firmware. If it runs stock V15, this page installs official Open first
Chrome or Edge on a computer, with MIDI and SysEx allowed
Anything you want to keep backed up. On official Open, M-VAVE's workbench backs up projects, samples and voices. Stock V15 has no project library for it to read

notes: Firmware 0.9.1 puts the DRUM keys and MIDI in the order of the screen. MIDI from C1 is a different sound on every note: existing DAW patterns will trigger different sounds, and MIDI MAP on GLOBAL gives the General MIDI notes back.
On PROJECTS, SAVE saves, OCT+ loads and OCT− erases, and the footer says so. A question stays on screen for 3 seconds. Saves from firmware 0.5.0 are no longer read.

It follows MIDI clock on any port, with start, stop, continue and song position. If PROJECTS says FLASH IN USE, tap SAVE and confirm: this erases four sectors of user Flash that stock firmware may have left data in. Nothing is erased until you confirm.

Tested on the host and in the FM-1 emulator, including under the chip's alignment rule. 0.9.1 has not run on a device. 0.9.0 runs on one unit with sound, USB audio, MIDI notes, MIDI clock over USB and saving. Bluetooth, long runs and leaving for official firmware are untested.
If an FM-1 is restarting at the start-up screen: power on holding HOME until SAFE MODE shows, then connect the installer. This has not been tried on a device.
